dedupe_keys.name: bane nor railway network banenettverk topological reference lines and nodes of the norwegian state railway infrastructure with kilometre referencing

description: Bane NOR, the state company that owns and manages Norway's railway infrastructure, publishes the Banenettverk dataset through Geonorge. Contents: reference lines for every railway line that is part of the state railway infrastructure, plus heritage railways, with located line geometry and nodes forming a topological network; values follow Bane NOR's linear referencing model (kilometre posts), and a companion dataset gives the linear references separately. Producer: Bane NOR SF. Coverage: the whole Norwegian rail network. Format and access: downloads in file geodatabase, GML, PostGIS and SOSI through the Geonorge download service, and a WMS view service; the dataset is updated annually, most recently in March 2025 according to the catalogue. Licence: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD). Caveats: reference lines per line section, not every track and switch, so yard layouts and signalling are not included; noise zones and train movement data are separate datasets. Simulation uses: network models for rail freight and passenger routing, linking train movement records to line sections through kilometre references, and landslide and flood exposure of lines. Related records: the Norwegian train traffic data 2013 to 2023 (data-norway-train-traffic-2013-2023) can be joined to this network.
